The '''Gizer system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gizer/Legends|Gizer]].
